The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Fulminiss]] maintained a '''base''' in the Lower [[Flamewood]] region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] during his time there, though he actually used it as a way of testing the reach of his Force powers when he drove the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentices]] there insane while in another region of Voss.
